title: 36 Hours in Raleigh, N.C.
abstract: North Carolina’s capital is awash with entrepreneurial energy, from clothing labels to craft breweries to ambitious restaurants.

title: 36 Hours in Nassau, the Bahamas
abstract: From beaches and birds to conch and cocktails, warm up with a weekend in this laid-back island town.

title: 36 Hours in Mexico City
abstract: Where to begin in the nearly 500-year-old capital? This weekend itinerary can get you started, with stops at museums and markets, bars and bell towers.

title: 36 Hours in Jamaica
abstract: Start in Kingston for cocktails and culture, then head north through verdant landscapes to sample Jamaican cuisine and catch some sun by the sea.
